name: SliceV2

y.description: Sliced tensor, shape determined by size parameter

description: torch_npu.npu_slice(input, offsets, size) extracts a slice from the input tensor. Equivalent PyTorch: input[tuple(slice(o, o+s) for o, s in zip(offsets, size))]. offsets and size are lists of ints specifying start indices and sizes per dimension.
